notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific facts are the October 1961 site purchase (quoted on the Central US Lookouts page from the agency's annual report, not read directly) and the Removed status. Nothing found gives a build date, design, height, staffing or removal date, and a 1961 land purchase does not show when a tower went up. The MDC article is general fire-tower history, used only for the 1936 agency date and 1966 counts. The MDC 2015 Douglas and Wright County towersites plan covers Squires, Twin Knobs and Blue Slip; it does not mention Dogwood. That is an absence, so it is left out of the story. The agency field carries the 1961 name from the page header, which is not a record error.
